profiles.name: Morning Adhkar
profiles.author: santarl
profiles.desc:
The morning remembrance of the Sunnah, for the start of the day.
Ordered from the most to the least authentic: Quran and Sahih first, then reports with weaker or disputed chains. Swipe up or down for the meaning, the transliteration, then the grading, reward and source of each slide.
Arabic follows Hisn al-Muslim; Quranic text is the Tanzil Uthmani text (tanzil.net), unmodified. Translation and transliteration are original.
